about: Names of the own .desktop entries per Win11 language. scripts/install.py writes them at install time in the language from settings.json; win11-panel --http-only (the backend of win11-shell, the native GTK 4 shell) rewrites Name= and Comment= of the installed entries at start and when the language changes (D-G4, notes/claude/contracts.md). nl values are byte-identical to install.py at 3b898e6. Calendar: the native Calendar app (win11-calendar). D-G70: the WebKit Desktop and Start entries are gone.
